title: Hurricane Maria: Health and Human Services in Fajardo
description: U.S. Department of Health and Human services tents, setup and operated by Disaster Medical Assistance Team New Mexico 1 and volunteer medical personnel, from Montefiore medical center, provide medical care for local citizens near the Hospital HIMA San Pablo in Fajardo, Puerto Rico, Oct. 23, 2017. The Federal Emergency Management Agency and its federal partners continue 24-hour operations to conduct life-saving rescue and medical missions. (US Air Force video by Airman 1st Class Franklin Harris)
